entries.aeaa0749cc5f7b7b: In July 2025, it formulated a new medium-term management plan (fiscal years ended May 2026 to May 2030) and states that its direction for strategic transformation consists of four pillars: clear separation of strategic and operational targets and optimization of resource allocation; fundamental strengthening of planning and marketing capabilities; promotion of partnership strategies toward building a customer base; and development of a resilient business portfolio that is not affected by the external environment. In the IoT-related business, it states that it will advance technology development, expand its product lineup and develop new customers in anticipation of the spread of physical AI in fields such as robotics, smart factories and mobility. In the Industry 4.0 promotion business, it states that its subsidiaries Myoritsu Seiki Co., Ltd. and Tokyo Technical Co., Ltd. will advance technology development in their respective business areas to expand market share, and will advance product and service development in the vibration solutions field and the AI image processing field.
